solution.en: Charge the UPS/Inverter fully, reduce connected load, check battery age, and test backup with one low-power device.
solution.bn: UPS/Inverter fully charge করুন, connected load কমান, battery age check করুন এবং একটি low-power device দিয়ে backup test করুন।

escalation_message.en: If backup is still low, share model, battery age, and connected load details.
escalation_message.bn: backup কম থাকলে model, battery age এবং connected load details লিখুন।

solution.en: Charge for 6-8 hours, check battery terminals, reduce load, and replace the battery if it is old or swollen.
solution.bn: ৬-৮ ঘণ্টা charge দিন, battery terminal check করুন, load কমান এবং battery old/swollen হলে replace করুন।

escalation_message.en: If battery warning continues, share battery age and UPS/Inverter model.
escalation_message.bn: battery warning থাকলে battery age এবং UPS/Inverter model লিখুন।

solution.en: Remove high-power devices, keep load within rated capacity, restart the UPS, and check if the alarm stops.
solution.bn: high-power device খুলে ফেলুন, rated capacity এর মধ্যে load রাখুন, UPS restart করুন এবং alarm বন্ধ হয় কি না দেখুন।

escalation_message.en: If alarm continues, share the load list and UPS model.
escalation_message.bn: alarm থাকলে connected load list এবং UPS model লিখুন।

solution.en: Check input voltage, charging cable, battery terminal, fuse, and charger indicator. Keep the inverter connected to stable power.
solution.bn: input voltage, charging cable, battery terminal, fuse এবং charger indicator check করুন। inverter stable power-এ connect রাখুন।

escalation_message.en: If it still does not charge, share inverter model and battery details.
escalation_message.bn: charge না হলে inverter model এবং battery details লিখুন।
